models.closure: Freeze completed living P,Q,diet,predation,accumulation,migration. Solve EE for SM; detritus accumulation absorbs routed inflow at fixed predation. No new consumption is assumed.
models.group_identity_source: UTF-8 frozen JSON group_seq/group_name; immutable numeric sequence.
limitations: The loader zeroes raw detritus export 1670.48071 and stores completed detritus excess as accumulation; excluded from fishery H and catch weights.
Small original source rounding residuals are preserved.
Published source-period landings/discards exist but a fleet return fate is not established.
models.baseline_validation: Existing saved workbook plus fresh unmodified frozen-calculator/zero-discard equality and independent analytic/conservation checks.
